Question: How do you construct the reflection of point \(A\) across line \(l\)?

Choices.A: Through \(A\), draw a line parallel to \(l\), and mark off a segment of equal length on the other side of \(l\).
Choices.B: Draw an arc centered at \(A\) with any radius, intersecting \(l\) at one point. That point is the required point.
Choices.C: Join \(A\) to any point \(P\) on \(l\) and extend to \(A'\) so that \(PA'=PA\).
Choices.D: Through \(A\), draw a perpendicular to \(l\), with foot \(O\). On the perpendicular on the other side, mark \(A'\) so that \(OA'=OA\). Then \(A'\) is the required point.

Solution: The segment joining a point and its reflection is perpendicularly bisected by the axis of reflection, so first construct a perpendicular, then locate a point at the same distance.

Original.prompt: 如何作点 A 关于直线 l 的对称点？

choices.text: 过 A 作 l 的平行线，在 l 的另一侧截取等长线段
以 A 为圆心、任意长为半径画弧交 l 于一点，该点即所求
连接 A 与 l 上任一点 P 并延长到 A′，使 PA′=PA
过 A 作 l 的垂线，垂足为 O，在垂线上另一侧截取 OA′=OA，A′ 即所求

Original.explanation: 对称点的连线被对称轴垂直平分，所以要先作垂线，再取等距点。
